name: Disclosure
summary: Reveals or hides a related content panel.

useWhen: Hiding optional detail about one thing that most people can skip
avoidWhen: Navigating to a different page; use Link
Related sections that people read together or compare; use DisclosureGroup
Alternative views of one subject shown one at a time; use Tabs

web.html.reason: No framework-free web implementation exists. Use the web.react binding.

behavior: Enter and Space toggle the panel
Expanded state is controllable or internally managed
The required title is the content of the trigger button, not a separate part, and children are the panel content
A collapsed panel keeps its content mounted, so the state and effects of that content continue while it is closed
A collapsed panel is marked inert and aria-hidden, so its content cannot be focused or clicked
Collapsing the Disclosure while focus is inside its panel moves focus to the trigger
accessibility: Expose a labelled button with expanded state and a controlled panel relationship
